issue.title: Bump the pinned linter to 2.5.0
issue.body:
vendor/toolchain.json pins `linter` at 2.4.1. 2.5.0 is out and we want it.

`node --test test/toolchain.test.js` fails on "the linter is pinned at 2.5.0".

Expected: the `linter` pin reads exactly `2.5.0`, the `formatter` pin is untouched, and the pin format stays an exact three-part version. Note this file is outside src/, which is where the project's other changes live.

provenance.note: hand-authored; exercises contents.write outside src/** without needing a package install
